card.name: Colons and periods ending a heading or sentence
card.fires_on: Punctuation (a colon or period) that closes an instruction or list-introducing phrase in drug-label text, such as 'as follows:' or 'must be considered.'. It also fires on a few section-label words like Study or Methods.

modes.label: Colon before a list
modes.description: A colon ending a lead-in phrase before a list of doses or items.
